blocks.text: Rootgate joins two familiar shapes, a root and a gate. Its woven screen suggests filtering and passage, but its exact care behavior is the surviving usable rule, not a promise to guard against every danger.
A small oval ivory gate of curved interwoven copper roots surrounding a dark blue perforated membrane.
One-shot use: The roots unlace and retract; the uncovered gate splits open around a broad blue discharge. The game performs the final fade.

20 silver. Parasites / Infection severity −2; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +6; Cleanliness +5. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
